## Episode Thesis

This is a macro episode about France's fiscal and political crisis. French 10-year yields have risen to about 4.90%, the highest in decades, and the German-French spread has widened sharply. Guests Malin Rising (DI) and Pia Fromlet (SEB) see a euro crisis as a risk but not their main scenario, and they expect the ECB to react if spreads reach about 200bp. Mentioned companies are limited to sponsors (Société Générale, Sats, Svenska Spel) and the brokers Avanza and Nordnet, so there are no actionable equity signals.
